entities.name: Authentication response parameter
entities.description: Provides the network with the authentication response calculated in the USIM. It is a type 4 information element with minimum length of 6 octets and maximum length of 18 octets.

entities.name: Authentication response parameter IEI
entities.description: Information element identifier for authentication response parameter, located in bits 8-5 of octet 1.

entities.name: Length of Authentication response parameter contents
entities.description: Length indicator of the authentication response parameter contents, located in bits 8-1 of octet 2.

entities.name: RES or RES*
entities.description: Contains the RES or RES* value, located in octets 3-18. RES is minimum 4 octets and up to 16 octets in EPS authentication challenge. RES* is 16 octets in 5G AKA authentication challenge.

entities.name: EPS authentication challenge
entities.description: Authentication procedure where the response calculated in the USIM (RES) is minimum 4 octets and may be up to 16 octets in length.

entities.name: 5G AKA authentication challenge
entities.description: Authentication procedure where the response calculated in the ME (RES*) is 16 octets in length.

relations.description: Authentication response parameter information element contains the IEI field.
Authentication response parameter information element contains the length field.
Authentication response parameter information element contains the RES/RES* field.
EPS authentication challenge uses RES field with minimum 4 octets and up to 16 octets length.
5G AKA authentication challenge uses RES* field with fixed 16 octets length.
